title: Quaint Garlicky Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish featuring tender lamb, whole black peppercorns, and a hint of yuzu, perfect for a crowd, this macrobiotic friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, garlic, whole black peppercorns, yuzu juice, olive oil, onion, salt, and thyme.
Transfer the mixture to a slate tile vessel, making sure the lamb is in a single layer.
Cover the vessel with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the top is lightly browned.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
